856-4247-5776-6277.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2034-3490-6824-8319.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6824-8319.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

206-751-6006.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

443-4279-4616--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-4279-4616--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2231-3899-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2231-3899-4871-5220.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1770-3821-4518.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
1770-3821-4518.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2906-3698-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
2906-3698-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
When Tatterkite enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

240-1753-2511-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

457-5159-5491-7295.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-5159-5491-7295.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

222-527-2438-7297.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2438-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

2645-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five other creatures
2645-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Brigid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1651-3129-3340-6871.description:
Activate Bootleggers' Stash by tapping it, as it's a land due to Toph, creating two Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat.

4094-5702-6202.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4094-5702-6202.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with mana to cast it.
4094-5702-6202.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Noyan Dar
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 5.

1636-2157.notablePrerequisites:
There is a creature token on the battlefield that entered this turn.
You control at least one mana-producing creature.
1636-2157.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a copy of a creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4268-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4268-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1978-3301-6893.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
1978-3301-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

3053-3918-4824.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two basic land types among lands you control
3053-3918-4824.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Trazyn using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2034-4359-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

413-1283-2440-5544.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters, Blasting Station and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Skeleton and/or Rogue you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

560-1563-1753-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

465-719-3742-4251-6791.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2468-2963-6587-6588.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

1202-1737-3698-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Moonvessel.
When the token Myr Moonvessel enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Grinding Station by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel and tapping it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, Myr Moonvessel and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3661-3698.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3661-3698.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

3000-5104-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5104-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

864-5352.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
864-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Eternal Witness and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Eternal Witness tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

509-4222-4851.notablePrerequisites:
Idris does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Idris.
509-4222-4851.description:
Activate Idris using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Idris.
Repeat.

1641-4050-4875.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {G}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

539-1636-3661-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
539-1636-3661-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Shield Sphere to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you control another nontoken creature without summoning sickness, this combo nets infinite mana creatures you control can produce.

3458-4050-4939-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary, adding {R/G}.
When Burning-Tree Emissary dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Burning-Tree Emissary on top of your library from your graveyard.
Actviate Impromptu Raid by paying {2}{R/G}, revealing Burning-Tree Emissary from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Repeat.

1124-2793-3062-4659-5089.manaNeeded: {2} on the first turn, with {7} available each subsequent turn
1124-2793-3062-4659-5089.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, and causes you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing any artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, revealing Ugin's Nexus from exile and putting it into your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

397-4871-5147.description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Citizen.
The Citizen dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
